text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm exhausted... Shower me with a little more praise, will you?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, just kidding! I've got an interview
coming
up, so I've still got to push
myself a little longer!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: And next up is the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.text: Oh, snap! Yeah, that's right!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
It's a doozy of a race—it'll be so
exciting! Let's do
everything we can to
prepare for the Satsuki Sho!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Okay then, I'm off to the interview.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
And so, the Spring Stakes, the prelude
to the
Classics, comes to an end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: That night...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Is that... Марузенски's Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Wow, you're working so late! You must
be tired!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
...Ack! Oh, no—that was supposed to be
secret!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You didn't see anything, okay? I'll get in
trouble
if anyone finds out I've been
running this late!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.text: O-okay! Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I really do enjoy running. Little
by little, I
really feel like I'm getting
better.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I'm even getting closer to running with
someone
like Марузенски...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Satsuki Sho, isn't it? I'm
sure it's
going to be an incredible race!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Grass and I are looking forward to
watching
Марузенски run, so please tell
her to really go for
it!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Great! Okay, good night!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
The young student, chasing after her
role model...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She seems so happy as she walks away.
It's a stark
contrast to how Марузенски
has been recently...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
